snippet.title: Heroes Never Die: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
If you've ever wondered what a fusion of Vampire Survivors and Heroes of Might and Magic would look like, then Heroes Never Die might be the game for you. It's a newly announced fantasy strategy game from developer Ludogram that "aims to take the best of the survival formula and fuse it with more tactical decisions, real-time army building, and powerful fantasy heroes." It will be released in 2027 for PC. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5275640/Heroes_Never_Die/
